# Radix Primitives downstream suite

[Radix Primitives](https://github.com/radix-ui/primitives)' `unit` project (Vitest, 47 files: dialogs, menus, select, slider, toast, form, axe checks), unmodified, on jsdom and on @ctrl/dom.

## Run

```sh
pnpm downstream:radix --install     # first run: clone the pinned commit and install its dependencies
pnpm downstream:radix --preset all  # what the results below track
```

Presets: `smoke` (6 packages), `interactions` (24 packages) and `all` (what the results track).
